from ghidra.app.util import PseudoDisassembler
import json
p=currentProgram
af=p.getAddressFactory()
d=PseudoDisassembler(p)
for start,n in [(0x141660b30,752),(0x141660e20,100),(0x14165bd40,115)]:
 a=af.getAddress(hex(start)[2:]);end=start+n
 while a.getOffset()<end:
  monitor.checkCancelled()
  i=d.disassemble(a)
  if i is None: print(hex(a.getOffset())+" <undecoded>");break
  print(hex(a.getOffset())+" "+str(i))
